  struct Box<T>
    field value: T
    field label: String
  struct Cell<T>
    field value: T
    field label: String
  typealias TextBox = Box<String>
  fun replaceBox<T>(box: Box<T>, value: T): Box<T>
    =
      CopyUpdate
        base
          Var box
        field value
          Var value
  fun replaceCell<T>(cell: Cell<T>, value: T): Cell<T>
    =
      CopyUpdate
        base
          Var cell
        field value
          Var value
  fun replaceAlias(box: TextBox): TextBox
    =
      CopyUpdate
        base
          Var box
        field value
          StringLiteral "alias"
  fun defaultCell(cell: Cell<String> = <expr>): Cell<String>
    =
      Var cell
  fun printIntCell(cell: Cell<Int>)
    Call println
      FieldAccess value
        Var cell
    Call println
      FieldAccess label
        Var cell
  fun printTextCell(cell: Cell<String>)
    Call println
      FieldAccess value
        Var cell
    Call println
      FieldAccess label
        Var cell
